pilot_grounding.limitation: A symmetric two-atom, 13-iteration SCF timing is not a relaxation, spin, molecule, metallic, large-cell or nosym workload forecast

allocation_rule: Planning envelopes only; no cap can be increased. A recorded reallocation is allowed inside the global cap before outcomes are used as selection criteria.
feasibility_gate: After first Phase3 reference/candidate jobs, forecast remaining queue from observed phase/size/k-mesh timings. Stop adding jobs if convergence and references cannot fit. Prefer one complete limited-set comparison over two incomplete cases.
full_inventory_forecast: Not promised: 161 original source cells, 21 >20-atom phases, maximum150 atoms and unresolved spin cases make a full convergence-checked recalculation unlikely within the 9000-second reference envelope.
fallback_full_inventory_forecast: Mg-O still has57 source cells and14 >20-atom phases; fallback means a smaller same-composition/limited-reference study, not an automatic complete hull
